verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the subscriptions doc, which says item prices carry a currency and must match the plan-item price's currency. That implies per-currency price points exist, but nothing shows local-currency invoicing workflows or any home-currency consolidation. Missing for 10: explicit multi-currency billing documentation, evidence of local-currency invoicing, consolidated reporting or conversion into a home/base currency, exchange-rate handling, and independent corroboration.
